Ceylon Tobacco profit up 10%, Rs 41 dividend 💰

Ceylon Tobacco Company PLC (CTC) made a profit after tax of Rs 7.58 billion in the July to September 2026 quarter. That is 10% more than a year ago.

Net revenue grew 7% to Rs 17.55 billion. For the first nine months, profit was Rs 21.97 billion, up 5%.

The company has declared a third interim dividend of Rs 41.00 a share, to be paid on 11 December 2026.

Source: CTC interim financial statements, Colombo Stock Exchange, https://cdn.cse.lk/cmt/upload_report_file/460_1794480547018.pdf
